entries.subject: DAMIT 156: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-156.txt. Model 156, version 2017-09-21, pole (3°, 15°), period 5.550877 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 200 ±15 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: Shape uses the shared missing-imagery grid. DAMIT's viewer illustrations are not source surface maps; no albedo, photographic color, regolith or composition is inferred.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 155: pole (359°, 8°), 5.550877 h, version 2009-08-27. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
